text:
Anna: Heads up — OrbisQ just spiked embeddings ingestion from their microservices team. Saw ~3x yesterday, looks like a new feature branch. @Diego can you check capacity? :eyes:
Diego: Looking. Which project/team?
Anna: OrbisQ -> team "search-microservices" requested docs + vector-store sync. They started scheduling hourly batch jobs.
Cleo: From OrbisQ PM — "we're rolling out personalized recs v2, need near-real-time embeddings for 50k items/day" (copied from customer note).
Mira: 50k/day is fine on hosted but bursts look like ~8k/hr right now. Do they need Dedicated? What's the SLA requirement?
Anna: They asked for <48h timeline and low inference latency. Renewal in ~2 quarters, they said success metrics tie to reduced cart drop.
Diego: Running top of queue now — capacity-bot auto-bump fired: "burst allowance +20%"
capacity-bot: auto-allocated 2 extra concurrent workers to hosted-pool-3 for org:orbisq (policy: short-burst).
Sam: We should propose a short-term reserved pod (1 week) as interim, plus a Dedicated pilot for multi-team scale. I'll draft a runbook + cost estimate.
Mira: Also need enablement: onboarding guide and recommended tunables. Quick snippet for batch tuning below:
```json
{"batch_size": 256, "concurrency": 4, "prefix_cache": true}
```
Anna: Action items — @Sam: draft proposal & pricing; @Diego: confirm perf numbers p50/p95 under burst; @Mira: prep onboarding checklist & notes for tokenization quirks; @Cleo: sync with customer tomorrow 11:00 PT.
Cleo: Confirmed 11:00 PT. Also flagging feedback: they reported tokenization issues on mixed HTML/docx content (some docs producing unusually long token counts).
Diego: Perf note from quick run: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms at current burst. With +2 workers p95 drops to ~220ms.
Anna: If they onboard the infra and multiple product teams, this is a clear expansion signal and a renewal opportunity. Marking as `renewal-opportunity` and flagging for CS exec review.
Sam: I'll include a 3-month usage projection and recommended next steps (reserved pilot -> Dedicated -> capacity plan). :thumbsup:
Anna: Great, thanks team — follow up in Monday CS weekly. :calendar:
